headline: Candidate interviews, discussion, and possible vote to hire a City Council Budget/Management Analyst.
summary: Two candidates, Gary Frisch and Katharine Foster, will be interviewed for the Budget/Management Analyst position. The meeting will also include discussion of the candidates and a possible vote to elect one.
